title: Act 1 - Segment 7: Cinnabar Island & Seafoam Islands (Volcano Badge)
synopsis: Navigate Routes 19 and 20, solve the boulder puzzles of Seafoam Islands to encounter Articuno, and explore Cinnabar Island. Infiltrate Pokémon Mansion to claim the Secret Key, revive prehistoric fossils at the Lab, and face Gym Leader Blaine's intense Fire lineup in a 4v4 duel under the Level 51 cap.
